Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
A vampire attempts to call a parity shift with a charming lobby. Having no
intercept I play Direct intervention on the charming. The meth calls the
parity shift anyway, and realises that now we're even and no one has more
pool than he does. Is the referendum canceled ?

If i played Direct intervention on a "seduction" card instead, the charming
lobby would have lead to a moot parity shift. What would happen to the next
vote, would the effect of the charming still in place ?

thanks
reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
reyda wrote:
>
> A vampire attempts to call a parity shift with a charming lobby. Having no
> intercept I play Direct intervention on the charming. The meth calls the
> parity shift anyway, and realises that now we're even and no one has more
> pool than he does. Is the referendum canceled ?

Moot. Parity Shift could not be legally played in the above example.

> If i played Direct intervention on a "seduction" card instead, the charming
> lobby would have lead to a moot parity shift. What would happen to the next
> vote, would the effect of the charming still in place ?

The Parity Shift referendum didn't pass, since it fizzled when the terms
could not be set.
